name: @flippydisk/nextjs-contentful-starter-kit
description: Next.js starter kit with ESLint, SCSS, Tailwind, Jest, local HTTPS certificates, and Contentful utilities.

scripts.predev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node ./bin/generate-tailwind-safelist.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node ./bin/generate-theme.js && cross-env node ./bin/ensure-dev-cert.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "cross-env node ./bin/generate-theme.js --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development WATCHPACK_POLLING=true next dev --webpack --experimental-https --experimental-https-key ./certificates/localhost-key.pem --experimental-https-cert ./certificates/localhost.pem"
scripts.dev:http: concurrently "cross-env node ./bin/generate-theme.js --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development WATCHPACK_POLLING=true next dev --webpack"
scripts.prebuild: cross-env NODE_ENV=production node ./bin/generate-tailwind-safelist.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node ./bin/generate-theme.js
scripts.prebuild:static: cross-env STATIC_EXPORT=true NODE_ENV=production node ./bin/generate-tailwind-safelist.js && cross-env STATIC_EXPORT=true NODE_ENV=production node ./bin/generate-theme.js
scripts.prebuild:github-pages: cross-env GITHUB_PAGES=true NODE_ENV=production node ./bin/generate-tailwind-safelist.js && cross-env GITHUB_PAGES=true NODE_ENV=production node ./bin/generate-theme.js
scripts.vercel-build: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.clean:dev: node -e "['.next','.next-dev','out'].forEach((dir) => require('fs').rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run jest
